◉ IRIS — Intelligent Realism & Image Synthesis — v1.8

NAME RECONCILIATION 003 — 2026-09-23
Build identity: IRIS v1.8 / Name Reconciliation 003 / 2026-09-23

- Closed IRIS.FORGE as an active internal identity.
- Removed the temporary IRIS.FOUNDRY replacement identity, prompt and module.
- No replacement worker created.
- Preserved IRIS authority for visual intelligence, research, generation, reconstruction, transformation, compositing, visual consistency, specialist rendering and visual QA.
- Added explicit delegation to global EDEN FORGE for deterministic technical processing, conversion, automation, scripts/tooling, pipelines, validation tooling, manifests and technical/package integration.
- Global EDEN FORGE remains unchanged and external.
- Retained earlier migration record as superseded historical provenance.

IRIS — INTELLIGENT REALISM & IMAGE SYNTHESIS — v1.8
CHANGELOG

VERSION
v1.8

DATE
2026-09-16

ADDED
• Batch Studio UI for list-oriented batch management.
• Open/import list workflow for JSON, CSV and TXT.
• range and selection-oriented batch controls.
• output/export-oriented batch workflow.
• dedicated Planner, Compiler, Provenance, Continuity, Calibration,
  Text/Markings, Red-Team and Controlled-Variants modules.
• stronger dependency-aware batch architecture.

CHANGED
• normalized package to Universal Project Naming & Packaging Standard v1.1.
• human-facing documentation now defaults to plain text (.txt).
• root directory now uses full canonical filesystem-safe project identity.
• internal filenames are concise and versioned where appropriate.

FIXED
• removed obsolete generic package identity from the release layout.
• removed Markdown as the default human-facing documentation format.
• clarified that standalone batch execution requires a connected image provider.

REMOVED
• obsolete duplicated README/architecture/changelog Markdown release documents.

COMPATIBILITY NOTES
v1.8 retains the v1.1 prompt architecture and expands it. Existing manifest
concepts remain usable, but paths/names in this normalized package differ.


VERSION v1.8

COMPATIBILITY NOTES

VERSION v1.8
DATE 2026-09-17
ADDED

COMPATIBILITY NOTES

v1.8 — UIX WORKSTATION IMPLEMENTATION
- Rebuilt Visual Workspace around content-first three-pane workstation UIX.
- Added canonical SOURCE / RESULT / SIDE-BY-SIDE / OVERLAY / DIFFERENCE views.
- Added persistent ◉ IRIS identity with LCAS status presentation.

- Added responsive mobile canvas-first interaction model.
- Added explicit allowed-change-set presentation for EDIT-LOCKED work.
- Added Visual DNA, Fidelity QA, locks/provenance and export inspector areas.
- Updated Batch Studio away from legacy TINY/COMPACT/FULL presentation model.
- Preserved truthful provider-required states rather than simulating execution.
